app.name: Pratikar
app.tagline: Privacy-first companion for 24-hour intimate image takedowns and tamper-evident proof in India
app.disclaimerNotice: Pratikar is an information and organization tool. It is NOT legal advice, does NOT remove content itself, and is NOT affiliated with any government, police, or tech platform.
app.tamperNotice: Evidence logs are tamper-evident (SHA-256 hash chain), not tamper-proof, and do not constitute a statutory digital certificate.
app.quickExitTooltip: Immediately leaves this site and clears active encryption keys from device memory.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Pratikar
onboarding.subtitle: Safe, offline, private assistance for dealing with non-consensual images and sextortion.
onboarding.whatIs1: Step-by-step guidance on invoking India's 24-hour statutory takedown rule (IT Rules 2021, Rule 3(2)(b)).
onboarding.whatIs2: Generates formal takedown complaints citing legal provisions and the Nov 2025 MeitY NCII SOP.
onboarding.whatIs3: Maintains an offline, encrypted, tamper-evident hash chain of evidence on your device.
onboarding.whatIs4: Exports a clean, printable case summary for cybercrime portals and police stations.
onboarding.whatIsNot1: It does NOT offer legal counsel or represent you in court.
onboarding.whatIsNot2: It does NOT remove images directly from the internet.
onboarding.whatIsNot3: It does NOT identify anonymous offenders or track IP addresses.
onboarding.whatIsNot4: It is NOT connected to any government, police, or platform database.
onboarding.ageQuestion: Is the person affected by these images or threats 18 years of age or older?
onboarding.minorStopBody: Because this involves a person under 18, standard automated takedown procedures are insufficient. Indian law treats non-consensual imagery of minors as child sexual abuse material (CSAM/CSAE) under the POCSO Act and IT Act.
onboarding.minorVisitNcrp: Report at cybercrime.gov.in under 'Report Crime Against Women & Children'
onboarding.minorContactParent: Confide in a trusted adult, parent, school counselor, or guardian.
onboarding.vaultSetupSubtitle: All your evidence and case details will be encrypted on this device using AES-256-GCM. No one—not even us—can recover your data without this passphrase.
onboarding.passphrasePlaceholder: Enter a strong passphrase or PIN (minimum 8 characters)
onboarding.passphraseWarning: Write this passphrase down or store it safely. If you lose it, your encrypted evidence cannot be recovered.
onboarding.passphraseTooShort: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters.

vault.unlockSubtitle: Enter your passphrase to decrypt your evidence ledger and active cases.
vault.lockedNotice: Vault is currently locked. Data is securely encrypted on this device.
vault.wipeConfirmBody: This will immediately erase the encrypted vault, all cases, all links, all evidence logs, and settings from this browser. This action cannot be undone.
vault.autoLockNotice: Vault auto-locks after 15 minutes of inactivity or when the tab is hidden.

cases.title: Case Management
cases.subtitle: Track incidents privately. All entries remain strictly on this device.
cases.noCases: No cases recorded yet. Start by creating your first case.
cases.modeAssisted: I am assisting someone else (friend, volunteer, advocate)
cases.situationTitle: What is happening? (Select all that apply)
cases.situationShared: Images or videos already posted/shared without consent
cases.situationThreatened: Being threatened with sharing / sextortion / blackmail
cases.situationMorphed: Images have been morphed, edited, or AI deepfaked
cases.situationFakeProfile: Fake profile or impersonation using personal photos
cases.demandMoreImages: Demanded more images or video calls
cases.demandNotes: Notes on demands (do not include abusive details)
cases.offenderTitle: Is the offender known to you?
cases.identifiersHint: Enter one per line. Do not contact the offender.
cases.personalDetailsTitle: Complainant Details (Optional, used only when generating formal notices)
cases.personalDetailsNotice: Optional: Only stored in your local encrypted vault. Never transmitted anywhere.

wizard.title: 24-Hour Redress Action Guide
wizard.subtitle: Step-by-step procedure according to Indian law and MeitY SOP (11 Nov 2025).

reports.title: 24-Hour Statutory Takedown Notices
reports.subtitle: Track formal notices submitted under Rule 3(2)(b) of IT Rules, 2021.

evidence.title: Tamper-Evident Evidence Vault
evidence.subtitle: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash chain verifying chronological records without storing intimate imagery.
evidence.warningBanner: STRICT PRIVACY POLICY: Never upload or store intimate photos or videos in this app. Only record text links, timestamps, notes, and file hashes computed on your device.
evidence.typeFileHash: Local File Hash (Fingerprint of Saved Screenshot)
evidence.fileHasherNotice: Select a screenshot or message file on your device. The app computes its cryptographic SHA-256 hash in memory and immediately discards the file. The image is NEVER saved or sent.
evidence.ledgerValid: Hash chain verified: all cryptographic links intact.
evidence.ledgerTampered: INTEGRITY WARNING: Hash chain mismatch detected at record #{seq}!

helplines.subtitle: Verified statutory avenues for victims of cyber offenses and NCII in India.
helplines.verifiedNotice: Information verified against MeitY SOP (11 November 2025) and official gazette notifications.
helplines.unverifiedNotice: Please verify before use: information marked with an unverified badge requires independent confirmation.
